title: Add bee knowledge show and bee knowledge new verbs
action: New file author.rs with run_show and run_new. show: --id <bee.id> (required) finds the one concept by bee.id via collect_concepts, prints path, type, title, description, tags, timestamp, every bee.* field, the body (concept_body), and the concept's outbound links (relative .md targets found in the body plus bee.required_context) and inbound referrers (other concepts whose body or required_context names this path); --json emits {path,data,body,links_out,links_in}; unknown id is ctx.fail. new: --type pattern|area --title T --summary D --area SLUG (all required) [--tags a,b] [--lifecycle L default active] [--file BODY.md]; builds the Map exactly like bootstrap build_area_concept, emits through emit_frontmatter, pattern lands at patterns/YYYYMMDD-<slug>.md with id pattern-YYYYMMDD-<slug>, area lands at areas/<area>/<slug>.md with id <area>-<slug>; slug via slug_from_stem(title); today via chrono Utc like run_bootstrap; refuses (ctx.fail) when the path exists or the id is already claimed; body defaults to a '# <title>' heading; then re-renders indexes via compute_index_files (same write loop run_index uses); --json emits {path,id,written:[...]}. Register both in mod.rs (mod author + use) and routing.rs match arms; add knowledge.show and knowledge.new entries to registry_payload.json (one-line JSON, python json.dumps separators=(',',':') ensure_ascii=True, no trailing newline). Reuse flags id,type,title,summary,area,tags,lifecycle,file,json only — no new flag names, PINNED_FLAG_COUNT stays 203.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml knowledge -- --nocapture 2>&1 | tail -20; then cargo test registry_contracts and catalog; then .bee/bin/bee knowledge check on the repo bundle stays OK
must_haves: bee knowledge show --id <id> prints the concept and its links; unknown id exits 1 with a one-line error
bee knowledge new writes a file that knowledge check reports as canonical (parse->re-emit identical) and re-renders index.md files
bee knowledge new refuses an existing path or a duplicate bee.id without writing
registry_payload.json carries knowledge.show and knowledge.new; tests/registry_contracts.rs and catalog flag pin (203) stay green
inline tests in author.rs cover show (found, not found, links) and new (pattern write canonical, area write, duplicate refusal)

trace.outcome: knowledge show and knowledge new verbs landed

report.outcome: knowledge show (path, frontmatter, body, links out/in) and knowledge new (canonical concept write, duplicate refusal, index re-render) landed in author.rs, routed and registered
report.tests: cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml knowledge, registry_contracts, catalog; bee knowledge check — green:unit — touched the knowledge verb group and the command registry only
